expected_result: A page containing an open modal dialog creates a genuine keyboard trap. The auditor must detect the trap, prove that keyboard focus cannot exit the modal via Tab/Shift+Tab, confirm that the Escape key fails to dismiss the modal, capture an interaction recording (.webm), and verify that an accessible modal (control) passes with zero findings.

actual_result: Auditor successfully identified a genuine keyboard trap on /tc1/bad (#newsletter-modal), logging 1 critical finding for WCAG 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap. Focus movement was tracked across 9 tab steps, detecting a loop of 3 elements (cycleDetected=true). Escape key was pressed but the modal remained open (modalStillOpenAfterEscape=true). Dismiss controls (#maybe-later-btn, #subscribe-btn) were activated via keyboard but failed to dismiss the dialog (dismissControlsWorked=false). Non-empty screenshot and .webm interaction recording were captured under /evidence/tc1-1792776770971/. The control page /tc1/good produced 0 findings with full keyboard exit support.
